item.title: Wooden Enclosure Design Considerations
item.description:
Two enclosure concepts are currently being considered for the HUB75 LED matrix display.

Rear assembly

In this concept, the enclosure is assembled from the rear.

The display panels, electronics and other internal parts are mounted from the back of the enclosure.

Removable top cover

In this concept, the top panel of the enclosure acts as a removable lid.

The plexiglass front and possibly a separate frame containing the LED panels can be inserted into the enclosure from the top.

item.title: Aluminium Frame Design Considerations
item.description:
The internal frame uses 20 × 20 mm aluminium construction profiles.

Main dimensions

Dimension Value
Overall width 840 mm
Overall height 360 mm
Horizontal profiles 840 mm
Vertical profiles 320 mm
Profile size 20 × 20 mm

The overall height consists of a 20 mm top profile, a 320 mm vertical profile and a 20 mm bottom profile.

Panel mounting

The five HUB75 panels will be mounted to the frame using custom brackets.

item.title: Finishing the Wooden Enclosure
item.description:
The current preference is a simple silver-grey wood stain.

The existing display enclosures appear to have a black finish. A lighter colour is preferred for the new display because it may be used in direct sunlight.

A silver-grey finish should:

  • be easy to apply;
  • require no more than two coats;
  • be suitable for the inside and outside of the enclosure;
  • provide a lighter finish than black;
  • allow some wood grain to remain visible.

Edge sealing

The sawn edges of the plywood should be sealed before applying the final finish.

item.title: Feet for the Enclosure
item.description:
This page contains possible feet for the HUB75 display enclosure.

Prices were checked in July 2026 and may change over time.

Requirements

The feet should:

  • protect the enclosure and the surface underneath it;
  • provide some grip;
  • keep the enclosure stable;
  • be suitable for mounting underneath the wooden enclosure.

item.title: Aluminium Extrusion Frame Idea
item.description:
Aluminium extrusion could be used to create a rigid and modular frame around the LED panels.

  • Simple Extruded Aluminum Frame for LED Panels — practical example of constructing an LED-panel frame using aluminium extrusion.
  • Useful Build Tips for Making LED Panel Frames — notes about measurements, magnetic mounting, wiring, DIN rail, controller mounting and power supplies.

item.title: Hinge Ideas
item.description:
This page contains 3D-printable hinge ideas for the HUB75 display enclosure.

The examples are possible starting points rather than final selections.

Stop hinge

MakerWorld — Stop Hinge

This hinge has an integrated stop that limits its maximum opening angle.

It may be useful for a lid or support panel that must stop at a defined angle without a separate cable or support arm.
